title: TLS Delegated Credentials：代理憑證的有效期交集
titleEn: TLS Delegated Credentials: delegated authority lifetime intersections
subcategoryTitle: 密碼協定、時間與量測證據

summary: 建立父憑證、DelegationUsage、代理公鑰與預期簽章演算法的測試描述；對缺授權、錯演算法及超出父有效期各留一個反例，先寫拒絕理由。
summaryEn: Create descriptors for the parent certificate, DelegationUsage authorization, delegated public key and expected signature algorithm. Include missing authorization, wrong algorithm and excessive lifetime as separate counterexamples with decisions written before evaluation.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.
